name: calendar_events_instances
description: Returns instances of the specified recurring event; a non-recurring event yields itself as its single instance. (GET /calendars/{calendarId}/events/{eventId}/instances)

calendar_id.description: Calendar identifier. To retrieve calendar IDs call the calendarList.list method.

time_min.description: Lower bound (exclusive) for an event's end time to filter by. Must be an RFC3339 timestamp.

time_max.description: Upper bound (exclusive) for an event's start time to filter by. Must be an RFC3339 timestamp.

max_results.description: Maximum number of events returned on one result page. Default 30.
